title: 'Thank you lang, OK na': Volunteers help meet gaps in BFP personnel, equipment
summary: In fire suppression operations, volunteer firefighters work alongside those from the Bureau of Fire Protection, but with no salary, stipend or other rewards, and even at their own expense.
